records.name: HX01 Product noir
records.description: Near-black canvas, 64–72px tight sans headline left, sub with a “New” link right, and a full product window that flattens from a tilt as it scrolls in. A dot field ripples behind it.

records.name: HX02 Serif noir
records.description: Black stage with drifting light streaks (Remotion loop), an announcement pill, a large regular-weight serif headline in a silver gradient, and a 3D cube cluster whose slices turn like a puzzle.

records.name: HX03 Shader aurora
records.description: A full-bleed WebGL gradient that flows in the theme’s colours (domain-warped noise) behind a centred headline, an inline email capture and a quiet logo row. CSS mesh fallback and film grain.

research.competitorRef: Stripe, Lovable, Gradientshub, Reflect, Index, Superlist; Unsection “Gradient” (151)

records.name: HX04 Editorial paper
records.description: Warm paper, a script label, a large book serif headline and a torn-paper collage: a photo with a ripped edge, lilac paper scraps and a hand-drawn paper plane that draws itself.

research.competitorRef: Amperos (Unsection: mission, insurance, ROI heroes), Marketer.com, FirstIndex, Popcorn, Delphi, Kettmeir

records.name: HX05 Kinetic wordmark
records.description: The brand name set edge to edge in a condensed display face, letters rising one by one, a photo window cut into the word, and a three-column meta row. The word tightens as it scrolls.

research.competitorRef: Rejouice, Exat, Monolith, Datalands, Cosmos Studio, Red Antler, Katana, Studio KARO; Unsection “Large type” (470)

records.name: HX06 Portrait name
records.description: A person’s name in huge type that inverts over a centred portrait (difference blend), a cursor-following “say hi” label, and side notes for role and location.

research.competitorRef: Lando Norris, Kael Donovan, Danish Chiragh, Eric Huguenin, Roman Salakhov, Nicolas Bussière

records.name: HX07 Orbit ring
records.description: Photos arranged on a slowly turning 3D ring around a centred headline; the ring tilts toward the pointer. Built with CSS 3D and GSAP, no WebGL.

research.competitorRef: Inkwell (ring of images), Glide customer stories (photo grid), Bychudy, Gallereee, Wishes; Unsection “Photo” media (345)

records.name: HX08 Floating tags
records.description: A calm centred headline with a rating badge; capability chips float around it at different depths (some blurred) and drift with the pointer. A product table peeks in at the bottom.

records.name: HX09 Answer engine
